name: Oath of the Crown
description: A paladin sworn to a nation, order, or throne, upholding law, loyalty, and duty above personal ambition.

oath_spells_by_level._notes: Real PHB/SCAG Oath of the Crown table — missing entirely until 2026-09-08 (this subclass's own features_by_level was built and verified against Enauweyn's real feature list, but its oath-spell table was simply never added in that pass, unlike sibling subclasses built the same session).
